Independent Round-2 review of PR #2909 (codex/story-1843-pr3) at head dbb682f679b2d877b9dc30c765a3170b898bde64 is complete:

Verdict: APPROVE (0 blocking findings, 2 non-blocking observations)
PR Comment: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2909#issuecomment-6391737840

Verification summary:
1. Round-1 blocker fixed: agent_handle::tests::story_1843_pr3_allocation_refuses_fifo_without_blocking now uses crate::aida_bin::current_executable_path() while preserving the self-re-exec child watchdog (AIDA_TEST_HANDLE_FIFO_CHILD=1, 5s deadline, kill+wait). All 8 CI checks are green at dbb682f679b2d877b9dc30c765a3170b898bde64.
2. F3 (LaunchReservationGuard): snapshots pre-existing unbound reservations for launcher PID and releases only newly created unbound reservations on Drop unless disarmed on spawn across all vendor headless, reviewer, and resume launch paths.
3. F4 (INHERITED_SESSION_ENV scrub & ancestor resolution): all 7 inherited session/handle env vars are scrubbed in apply_child_identity and spawn_claude_resume_with_grant; spawn_claude_headless_resume_granted now preserves resumed handle via apply_resumed_child_agent_identity; handle/sender/inbox resolution checks nearest vendor ancestor PID before env fallback; cmdline_matches_agent halts at -c/-lc/-e so hook/prompt arguments cannot misidentify a shell/client process.
4. F5 (Bounded probes/reads/locks & agent gc archival): O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK lock_namespace (250ms cap) and read_allocation_text (size-bounded); bounded_records caps directory scans at 4096 entries / 250ms and fails closed; monotonic counters under handles/counters/<prefix> with 64-probe cap and SHA-256 native_session_id index; agent gc archives expired unbound reservations to handles/retired/ and ended registry entries to agents/retired/.
5. Agy mail delivery & black-box test (STORY-1843.ac0eef56): antigravity-hooks.json wires PreInvocation -> aida-mail-notice.sh --client agy; scaffold_antigravity_hooks merges missing keys into existing .agents/hooks.json; black-box tests (aida-cli/tests/story_1843_pr3_blackbox.rs and tests/test_story_1843_pr3.py) verify claude1/codex1/agy1 handles and mail delivery.
6. Non-completion of STORY-1843: PR title uses (Refs STORY-1843) and body declares 'Non-completing slice for STORY-1843', leaving PR4 relay work open.

Note on attested verdict recording:
Running `aida review record` inside agy1 refused with:
`Error: refused: implementer seat cannot record a review verdict (self-review)`
because agy1's shell holds implementer grant `df7e873b-aa69-4185-8621-376f74f5f950` (harness pid 837172) and AIDA-managed agent sessions cannot self-issue TTY reviewer grants. To record the attested verdict, either bind a reviewer grant to pid 837172 (`aida role enter reviewer --bind-pid 837172`) or run from a reviewer seat:
`aida review record STORY-1843 --pr 2909 --verdict approved --sha dbb682f679b2d877b9dc30c765a3170b898bde64 --branch codex/story-1843-pr3 --comment-url https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2909#issuecomment-6391737840 --summary 'Round-1 FIFO watchdog current_executable_path fix verified; F3 LaunchReservationGuard, F4 INHERITED_SESSION_ENV scrub, F5 bounded probes/counters/GC archival, and Agy PreInvocation mail hook verified; non-completing (Refs STORY-1843) leaves PR4 relay work open.'`
subject: PR #2909 (STORY-1843 PR3) Round 2 Review: APPROVE at dbb682f679 (need reviewer grant to record verdict)
